_about: Machine-readable stage list derived from pipeline_design.md. Edit this when the design changes, then run: python experiments/experiment_5/tools/scaffold_stages.py. Nodes = stage x task. 'purpose' may be a string or {task: string}. '{task}' in depends_on is replaced by the node's task.

stages.title: Problem statement
stages.purpose: Fix both checkout tasks, prediction time, stakeholders and their actions, targets and label rules, metrics, the illustrative FN:FP = 5:1 cost, model families, decision rule, search budget and seed 42 - before any result.
outputs: task_contract.md (prediction time, stakeholder action, limits, metric and model rationale with verified citations)
gate: Every number later stages need is in protocol.yaml
Decision rule and tie-breaks written before any result
Stakeholder action stated, not only named
Every citation verified to exist and support its claim
stages.gate_question: Are tasks, targets, metrics, cost, decision rule and budget fixed before any result?

stages.title: Data preprocessing
stages.purpose: Load and clean the nine Olist tables deterministically, join aggregation-first to one row per order, build both targets with label-availability timestamps, audit every column against checkout time and apply the zero-item classification rule.
outputs: records.csv.gz (IDs for audit + features + targets + timestamps)
gate: Only row-local deterministic rules; nothing learned
Every column classified as known or not known at checkout
Minimum vs first review label sensitivity recorded
Input hashes recorded
stages.gate_question: Are joins, grains, targets and leakage exclusions verified?

stages.title: EDA
stages.purpose: Question-driven EDA on pre-cutoff orders only: target shape and tails, outcome trends over time, feature-target relationships, missingness, outliers and collinearity (correlation, VIF, rank).
outputs: candidate_rationale.csv (finding, evidence, change it motivates, stage that tests it)
gate: No order on or after the test cutoff loaded
Outcome trends shown, not volume only
Each proposed change linked to an observation
stages.gate_question: Does every planned change follow from a pre-cutoff observation?

stages.title: Features
stages.purpose: Define, without fitting: the 27-feature baseline; log transforms and a target-cap step whose value is chosen later on the folds; label-free reduction to a core set; rationale and citations; candidate feature sets per model; the pipeline recipe per model (impute, encode, scale).
outputs: feature_dictionary.csv (formula, grain, availability, missingness, rationale, citation)
gate: Only label-free checks used for reduction
Cap value not fixed here; candidates declared in protocol.yaml
Every retained feature has a rationale
Nothing fitted on data
stages.gate_question: Are features and recipes defined without fitting or using labels?

stages.title: Partition
stages.purpose: Hold out the test cohort (exact IDs frozen) and build chronological expanding CV folds on development orders with customer purge, label maturity and class-support checks; seed 42 documented.
outputs: counts.json (rows, customers, positives per fold and cohort)
checks.json (overlap, maturity, rows lost to maturity, class support)
gate: No test-cohort ID in development
Customers purged across training and validation
Training outcomes available before each fold origin
Both classes present in every fold (classification)
stages.gate_question: Are folds chronological, customers purged, labels mature and classes supported?

stages.title: Training

purpose.regression: On the s05 folds: median dummy, plain LinearRegression, single decision tree, random forest, each one Pipeline from the s04 recipe; residuals and learning curves; choose each model's feature set, the log transforms and the target-cap value on the folds.
purpose.classification: On the s05 folds: prior dummy, unregularised LogisticRegression, single decision tree, random forest, each one Pipeline from the s04 recipe; learning curves; choose each model's feature set and transforms on the folds.

gate: Identical rows and folds for every candidate
Preprocessing fitted inside folds
Simplest model of each family present
One change at a time under the decision rule
stages.gate_question: Do the models run basic to complex on identical folds, with each choice justified?

stages.title: Tuning

purpose.regression: Bounded grids on the same folds: Ridge alpha; tree depth and leaf; forest depth and leaf. Every candidate a whole pipeline.
purpose.classification: Bounded grids on the same folds: logistic C; tree depth and leaf; forest depth and leaf; class weight None vs balanced. Every candidate a whole pipeline.

outputs: grid_results.csv (every config: params, fold scores, mean, SD, rank, runtime, convergence)
gate: Grids taken from protocol.yaml
No configuration switched after the search
Pooled out-of-fold and mean-fold scores kept distinct
stages.gate_question: Is every tuned candidate a complete pipeline scored on the same folds?

stages.title: Selection

purpose.regression: Select the model on threshold-free scores against the dummy and simplest models; freeze the recipe; fit on all development orders; score the test cohort once.
purpose.classification: Select the model on threshold-free scores against the dummy and simplest models; check calibration; choose the threshold from out-of-fold predictions under the 5:1 cost; freeze; fit on all development orders; score the test cohort once.

outputs: bundle/ (pipeline, threshold, schema, versions, training-ID digest, checksums)
gate: Model selected before the threshold
Recipe and threshold frozen before the test cohort is read
Test cohort scored once
stages.gate_question: Was the recipe frozen before the test cohort was scored once?

stages.title: Conclusion
stages.purpose: Train-validation-test table with bootstrap confidence intervals, subgroup errors and drift, interpretation of the selected model, stakeholder actions supported by the evidence, and limitations.
gate: Importance explains the selected model
Test cohort described as historical held-out, not unseen
Every recommendation traced to evidence
stages.gate_question: Does every conclusion follow from the test results and their limits?

stages.title: Release
stages.purpose: Reload parity of the bundles; team approval; lead-ordered migration with a reproduction README (README section 12); reproduction check; then the Streamlit app and dashboard, report and slides from the reproduced outputs, walkthrough notebook, and input checks with error handling.
outputs: app/ and dashboard (inside experiments/experiment_5 until migration)
deliverables/ report and deck drafts citing evidence IDs
gate: App loads the s08 bundle unchanged
Reproduction check matches the release before any deliverable is built
Nothing written outside experiments/experiment_5/ before the lead orders migration
stages.gate_question: Do the app, dashboard, report and slides all trace to one reproduced release?
